cases.subject: I'm investigating a dead air issue in this call
cases.summary: Dead air on WebSocket bidirectional streaming calls — marks not returned, audio not played.

analysis.method: PCAP extraction and analysis of SSRC payloads
keyFindings: SSRC 0x733A270B (outbound to caller) is entirely 0xFF (PCMU silence) on every packet
Audio from Stella's WebSocket server is NOT being injected into the call
Root cause: likely wrong payload format (not base64-encoded), rate limiting (>1 payload/sec), or malformed WebSocket event structure
analysis.recommendation: Verify WebSocket payload format (base64-encoded raw audio), rate limiting, and event structure against docs

cases.subject: Telnyx team, we're investigating a possible false voicemail/AMD classification
cases.summary: False AMD classification — received machine_start but call was answered by human.

analysis.method: TeXML AMD callback API documentation review
keyFindings: machine_start is an INTERMEDIATE state, not a final classification
Final machine states are: machine_end_beep, machine_end_silence, machine_end_other
Customer's app logic was wrong: treating machine_start as confirmed voicemail instead of waiting for machine_end_*
analysis.recommendation: Update app logic to wait for machine_end_* events; consider Premium AMD for higher accuracy

cases.subject: Voice Design Lab - Custom Voice Upload Processing Failure (404 Errors)
cases.summary: Custom voice uploads 'phil-voice-1' and 'phil-voice-2' appear in Voice Design Lab but return 404 on playback/use.

analysis.method: Account lookup and Voice Clone docs review
keyFindings: Auto-account-lookup failed for electronicalias@gmail.com — need to verify actual Telnyx account email
Voice clone processing likely failed, entries stuck in DB
Name collision on re-upload confirms entries exist but are unusable
analysis.recommendation: Get actual account email, determine which model (Qwen3TTS vs Ultra), check audio file format compliance
